artworks.title: Nicholas Boileau
artworks.artist: François Chereau I after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: This is a portrait showing the upper body of a man, depicted from the chest up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but looking forward, with a slight, content expression on his face. The man has deep-set eyes, a Roman nose, long, voluminous, curly hair cascading down to his shoulders, and is wearing a robe or cloak with a visible ruffled or cravat collar. The background is a plain, subtly textured surface.

artworks.title: Pierre Louis Moreau de Maupertuis
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a person in elaborate clothing seated next to a column with one arm on a globe and the other arm pointing outward. The individual has a focused expression with defined facial features, curly dark hair, and light skin. They are wearing fur-trimmed clothing with intricate patterns, a fur hat, and a belt with an ornate medallion. The background features architectural elements, a drape, stone arches, and a landscape with mountains and smoke. In the lower portion of the image, there is a canoe with a person and a likely reindeer.

artworks.title: A Young Man with a Staff
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kate Ganz, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person seen from behind, in a walking or gesturing pose. The figure has curly hair, and their right arm is extended forward. The clothing is depicted with loose strokes to show folds and movement. The background is plain. The sketch has a rough and expressive style with strong lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Death of Saint Joseph
artworks.medium: watercolor, graphite, and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Louisa C. Duemling, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This painting shows a man lying on a bed attended by people with halos of light around their heads. The man is laying horizontally, his head on the right and his feet towards the left. He has a beard, a white cloth over his curly hair, and a white garment on, and his hands are clasped upright on his chest. His lower body and legs are beneath a textured blue blanket. A man and a woman are by his head, holding him. They are both robed in white, and the man has brown hair and a brown beard, while the woman has a long cloth covering her hair. All three people have white skin with hints of pale pink, light blue, and gray. Above the three people, an arched rainbow stretches across the top of the painting. Within the rows of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and pink are faint cherubic faces surrounded by wings, all looking down. The background is dark, with lines radiating outward from the three people.

artworks.title: Composition de F. Millet (Composition by F. Millet)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper (facing _Composition de F. Millet_ by Albert Merat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard A. Simms, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. Their head is slightly tilted downwards, gazing at the ground or the object they are holding. Their facial features are not detailed, and their hair is mostly covered by a wide-brimmed hat. The individual wears a long-sleeved garment, a long skirt, and flat shoes. They hold a spindle wrapped with fibers in their right hand. The background features gentle hills and grazing animals, likely sheep or goats, giving a rural setting. The artwork is textured, with lines creating depth in the figure and landscape.

artworks.title: L'Eclair (Lightning)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper (facing _L'Eclair_ by Paul Meurice)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard A. Simms, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ruins and rugged terrain. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The horizon is placed in the upper third of the composition with tall, dark structures against the night sky. The artwork uses intricate cross-hatching and line work for texture and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white, enhancing contrast. There are rough formations and remnants of walls or arches nearby, leading towards the distant structures. The background features a thickly inked sky.

artworks.title: Fleur Exotique (Exotic Flower)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on laid paper (facing _Fleur Exotique_ by Armand Renaud)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard A. Simms, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is slightly turned to the side, facing the viewer. The woman has distinct facial features, long dark hair, and is wearing a dark gown with a shawl or wrap covering her shoulders. She is holding a folding fan and a small bouquet of flowers. The background is a textured stippling.

artworks.title: The End (La Fin de Tout)
artworks.medium: etching with chalk additions in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. One person is lying down with their head on a pillow, covered by a blanket. Another individual stands near the bed, facing the person lying down. In the background, there is a candleholder on the wall with a lit candle, casting light in the room. Another figure is partially visible, peering from a corner on the right side.

artworks.title: The End (La Fin de Tout)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an interaction. One figure is lying in a reclined position on a bed, their head supported by a cushion. Another figure is standing beside them, leaning over with a gentle posture. The reclining figure has a relaxed facial expression and long, dark hair, with closed eyes. The standing figure wears a draped cloak, partially covering their head and their hands rest on the reclining figure's arm. Surrounding them are additional figures—one seated at the foot of the bed with a downcast face, while another stands holding an object. The room is dimly lit with a simple wall, and a candle illuminates the scene from above, creating intricate light and shadow patterns. The figures are dressed in simple, flowing garments, enhancing the somber and tranquil atmosphere of the setting.

artworks.title: The Suicide (Le Suicide)
artworks.medium: etching in black with plate tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a print of a person crouched on the edge of a bridge with a road on the left, with a horse-drawn cart passing over it and the skyline of a city in the distance. The road stretches into the distance, bordered by the outlines of tall buildings. The person in the center is hunched over, with their head resting on their arms, as they sit on the edge of what appears to be a bridge or elevated path. The edge of the bridge falls off in a sheer drop toward the bottom-right corner, and we can’t see what is below it.

artworks.title: The Suicide (Le Suicide)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: An individual is seated on a sloped surface, possibly a riverbank or a bridge. They are hunched over with their head resting on their arms and supported by their knees. The person's face is obscured from view, with their hair falling over their shoulders. They are wearing a dark, voluminous garment and there are no visible accessories or objects in their hands. The scene is dimly lit, suggesting an evening or nighttime setting. In the background, a street extends into the distance with an old-fashioned horse-drawn carriage moving along it. Streetlamps line the road and a city skyline is visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Dancer of Tanjore (La bayadère de Tanjore)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on Fabriano wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a dynamic setting. The artwork shows a sketch-like composition with various figures positioned in an animated manner. The figures are arranged in a rhythmic flow, with one figure raising an arm towards the upper part of the image, while others are seated or reclining nearby. The background is textured with fine lines and hatching, providing depth and atmosphere. Soft shading and expressive lines suggest motion and emotion, capturing a moment of interaction or a narrative.

artworks.title: The Dancer of Tanjore (La bayadère de Tanjore)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows one person dancing in the foreground. The individual is dressed in cultural attire and appears to be in motion, with one arm raised and the other hand near the back of the head. Surrounding the dancer are other figures, one of whom is seated and possibly playing a musical instrument. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: The Dancer of Tanjore (La bayadère de Tanjore)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring abstract movement and musicality. There is a central figure in an expressive pose, with intricate cross-hatched lines for textures and shadows. The background is a blend of swirling patterns, creating a lively rhythm. Another figure is present, holding a possible musical object, enhancing the expressive depth of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Dancer of Tanjore (La bayadère de Tanjore)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of two figures: a musician and a dancer. The dancer is depicted from behind, showcasing their entire body as they perform in the center of the image. The dancer's arm is raised while another is bent, embodying movement. The dancer's face cannot be seen, but their hair is styled up. They wear a flowing skirt with a tight-fitting top, giving the illusion of layered fabric. The musician, situated on the left side, is depicted from the waist up, with a visible face and close-cropped hair or head covering. They play a stringed instrument, holding it with one hand and using a bow with the other. The background features intricate, abstract patterns indicating a dark, indoor setting that contrasts with the figures.

artworks.title: Queen Elisabeth of Belgium (La Reine Élisabeth de Belgique)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing forward with their head slightly tilted. The portrait emphasizes the facial features, hat, and clothing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Queen Elisabeth of Belgium (La Reine Élisabeth de Belgique)
artworks.medium: etching, dypoint, and printed tone on Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person, focusing primarily on the head and shoulders. The individual is positioned facing directly forward, with a slightly tilted head. The facial features are softly defined, with light shading accentuating the eyes, nose, and lips. The person's hair is short, with some shading suggesting texture and depth. They are wearing a dark garment and a hat that casts a shadow over the upper face. No jewelry or additional objects are visible in the image. The background is plain and textured, filled with a cross-hatched pattern that complements the etched style of the portrait, emphasizing the subject as the central focus.

artworks.title: Queen Elisabeth of Belgium (La Reine Élisabeth de Belgique)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's face and neck, facing forward. The individual's head is slightly tilted back, looking straight ahead. Their facial features include distinct eyes and closed lips. The hair is styled with soft waves, and it is either short or tied back. The background is dark and textured, emphasizing the face's detailing and expression.

artworks.title: Queen Elisabeth of Belgium (La Reine Élisabeth de Belgique)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the head and a portion of the neck of a person, centered in the frame. The person is depicted in a frontal view with a slightly angled downward gaze. Their facial features are defined yet slightly obscured with darker shading, creating a dramatic contrast. They have short, dark hair that is partially covered by a hat. The person appears to be wearing a simple, dark garment which blends into the shaded background. The background itself is uniformly dark.

artworks.title: Pope Benedict XV (Benoit XV)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a man's face, showing the head and a small portion of the upper torso. The man's head is depicted from a frontal position. His facial features are detailed through fine lines and shading, with prominent cheekbones, eyes, a relatively large nose, and lips that are slightly pursed or neutral. The hair appears dark and is closely cropped around the head. The drawing suggests he may be wearing a light-colored shirt, discernible by the outline of a collar. There are no visible details of jewelry or objects being held. The background of the image is plain, focusing entirely on the intricately detailed face.

artworks.title: Gabriele D'Annunzio
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders view of a person with their face turned slightly to the right. The person has a noticeable forehead and brow, deeply set eyes, and sparse hair with the top of the head appearing mostly bald. The person wears a garment with a plain collar, likely a shirt. The rest of the clothing is not clearly visible because of the high-contrast style of the image. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background features dark, abstract patterns in various gradients and textures.

artworks.title: A Nude Woman in a Fur Wrap
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper (proof impression from an earlier state)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a woman seated with her upper body exposed, partially covered by fur. She is sitting back with a slight slouch, head tilted downward. The soft etching technique gives her indistinct facial features with subtle lines for eyes, nose, and mouth. Her hair is tied back smoothly with shaggy ends. She appears draped in fur-like texture, sitting on a piece of furniture. The background shows linear textures, possibly representing furniture patterns and a rough, sketched quality.

artworks.title: A Nude Woman in a Fur Wrap
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper (proof impression from a later state)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a person from the head to just below the shoulders. The person is seated with a slight lean and is partially wrapped in textured fabric or fur. The facial features are soft and somewhat obscured, with short hair closely cropped to the scalp. The person's clothing is not clearly visible, as a dark, dense pattern predominates the image. The surrounding environment appears textured and abstract, with swirling lines suggesting a richly textured background, implying a cozy, enclosed space. Deep shadows and highlights are used to form the contours of both the person and the surroundings.

artworks.title: By the Lamp (Sous la Lampe)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (proof impression of the first state)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman sitting at a table. She is facing slightly to the left, with her body turned toward the table as she leans over it. The woman's head, shoulders, and part of her arms are visible. She has delicate facial features, a smooth complexion, and a calm, neutral expression. Her hair is styled close to her head. She is wearing a dress with puffed sleeves and there is a suggested decorative detail or brooch at her neckline. A tablecloth covers the table, on which sits a small lamp with a simple shade, illuminating the scene. The background is textured and dark, creating a contrast with the lighter tones of the woman and table.
